provenance.coupling: Block Gauss–Seidel co-simulation: switching timeline → bus energisation (NetworkX) → pump availability (energised and V ≥ 0.90 pu, latching undervoltage trip) → EPANET 2.2 extended-period hydraulics (60 s step, pressure-driven demand) → pump electrical demand P = ρgQH/η (pf 0.85) → pandapower AC Newton–Raphson power flow every frame → pump-bus voltage re-check; repeated until the pump schedule is a fixed point (≤ 4 iterations). Final run: 1 iteration(s), converged.

events.title: Normal operation
events.detail: Demand 3256 kW (incl. 43 kW pumping), Vmin 0.923 pu at B18; 2/2 pumps running, tanks T1 50%, T2 50%; minimum service pressure 36.9 m.

events.title: Fault on Feeder F3 · line B32–B33
SW-06-26 tripped
events.detail: Protection opened SW-06-26: 8 buses (B26, B27, B28, B29, B30, B31, B32, B33) de-energised, 829 kW interrupted; facilities affected: City Hospital, Pumping Station PS-2, District Cooling Plant DC-1.

events.title: City Hospital on backup generation
events.detail: Genset 150 kW carries the essential electrical load; it does not supply water.

events.title: PU-2 stopped (PS-2 duty pump)
events.detail: Supply bus B33 de-energised; zone now depends on tank storage.

events.title: Faulted section isolated
events.detail: Opened SW-32-33; reclosed SW-06-26 — B26, B27, B28, B29, B30, B31, B32 re-energised. Isolated section: B33; still de-energised: —.

events.title: Cascading impact evaluated
events.detail: Without further switching: PU-2 offline; projected: Tank T2 below 25% at 17:40; projected: City Hospital pressure below 20 m at 18:12 (coupled power flow + extended-period hydraulic projection).

events.title: 1 recovery candidates evaluated
events.detail: Each candidate solved with AC power flow and the extended-period hydraulic model; 1 feasible, 0 rejected.

events.title: Plan C01 Simulation Verified
events.detail: No further switching (keep post-isolation configuration). Independent re-solve: 8 hard checks passed; advisories: Voltage advisory (soft), Critical-facility water pressure (soft), Tank level above minimum (soft), Critical facility service (soft).

events.title: No further switching
events.detail: The verified plan keeps the post-isolation configuration.

events.title: Tank T2 empty
events.detail: Elevated Tank T2 (West) reached its minimum operating level; the zone has no remaining storage.

events.title: City Hospital pressure below 20 m
events.detail: J-HOSP at 0.0 m — below the service threshold.

events.title: End of simulation horizon
events.detail: Served 3660 of 3739 kW; 1/2 pumps running; critical-facility pressure 0.0 m; tanks T1 53%, T2 0%.

timeline.label: Service restored
timeline.detail: 92% of interrupted load served at end of horizon
